# https://payme.stoplight.io/docs/4-b2b-payments---api-reference/4c8409538a75d-update-contract-related-files

Update Contract Related Files
PUT
https://sandbox.payme.io/api/payment-contracts/CONT{GUID}/invoices/

Add /INV{GUID} to the end of the URL to edit a document. Upadte a contract related file. It is possible to upload one file for another, should be the same type.

Send API Request
Staging
Request Sample: Shell / cURL
curl --request PUT \
  --url https://sandbox.payme.io/api/payment-contracts/CONT{GUID}/invoices/ \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
  "name": "test3.png",
  "type": "Invoice Receipt",
  "base64": "",
